newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: Zambia denies Zaire rebels using its territory.
newsitem.headline: Zambia denies Zaire rebels using its territory.

text.p: Foreign Minister Lawrence Shimba said on Wednesday Zambia would not allow anyone to use its territory to launch attacks on neighbouring Zaire.
"We shall not allow Zambian territory to be used by any self-styled forces to attack any of our neighbours," he told Reuters.
Shimba was responding to Zambian press reports that opponents of Zairean President Mobutu Sese Seko who had been living in Zambia as refugees had returned home to join rebel leader Laurent Kabila.

"We do not know whether such a force exists and have no idea whether they want to attack Zaire," Shimba said. "We shall not allow ourselves to be drawn into the Zairean war. That is their internal problem."
